stories.title: The role of climate change in the Nepal floods
stories.summary: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.

stories.title: The Sisyphean path it took to get 'Coyote vs. Acme' to the big screen
stories.summary: Warner Brothers' decision three years ago to shelve a live action animated movie with Wile E. Coyote and the Roadrunner upset many fans. Here's what its release tells us about Hollywood economics.

stories.title: Six months of war with Iran: Is anybody winning?
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with correspondents Greg Myre, Daniel Estrin and Hadeel Al-Shalchi about where things stand with the U.S.-Iran war — diplomatically, economically and militarily.

stories.title: Syria's breakaway Kurds relinquish autonomy and rejoin the country
stories.summary: Syria's Kurds, once backed by the U.S. to fight ISIS, have relinquished autonomy and dissolved their army to rejoin Syria.

stories.title: Political bickering follows two deaths related to measles in Pennsylvania
stories.summary: This week, Pennsylvania officials reported two measles-related deaths. Those deaths have now become wrapped up in politics. The country is in the midst of a record-setting number of measles cases.

stories.title: A drug just approved for pancreatic cancer opens a new chapter in treatment
stories.summary: The FDA just approved a breakthrough drug for metastatic pancreatic cancer, which is notoriously hard to treat. In clinical trials, the new pill roughly doubled how long patients survived.
